value.rationale: The smallest four-dimensional domino box already exhibits frozen components, making its unique non-frozen sector a natural quantitative reconfiguration benchmark. Exact shortest-move diameter, all-pairs distance distribution, and structured exceptional antipodes distinguish rigorous dynamical complexity from known component counts; these are motivated finite invariants, not arbitrary subsets.
